item.title: Glint 0.1.12
item.description:
Four ideas from Arc, kept light.

  • Quick window: links from other apps open in a small window with just the page. Open in Glint (⌘O) moves it into your tabs. Turn it off in Settings ▸ General.
  • Zap: ⋮ ▸ Hide Part of Page…, then click a banner, sidebar or box you never want to see; it stays hidden on that site. ⋮ ▸ Show Hidden Parts brings it back.
  • Pinned tabs spring back: a pinned tab remembers its page. Wander off and a pin in the address bar takes you back.
  • Close tabs you've left: in Settings ▸ Tabs, Glint can close tabs you haven't opened in 12 hours, a day, a week or a month. Off unless you choose; pinned tabs and tabs playing sound always stay.

item.title: Glint 0.1.11
item.description:
Installs like a Mac app, with a short welcome tour.

  • Install window: opening the download shows Glint, an arrow and Applications. Drag Glint across to install it.
  • Install from the app: if you open Glint straight from the download, it offers to install itself in Applications, replacing an older copy and keeping your tabs.
  • Welcome tour: five quick cards the first time Glint opens: Ask, tabs in the sidebar, privacy and profiles, then your look, your history and your default browser. Help ▸ Welcome Tour shows it again.

Already on 0.1.9 or later? Click Update in the toolbar.

item.title: Glint 0.1.10
item.description:
A tab overview that feels like a place.

  • New look: misty dunes along the bottom, at dawn in light mode and by moonlight in dark. A few tabs show large and centred; many fill more, smaller columns.
  • Clearer cards: each card shows its site and when you last looked at it. Empty tabs and Settings get calm cards instead of tiny screenshots, and the tab you're on has a soft halo.
  • Recently closed: tabs you closed sit at the bottom of the overview; one click brings one back.
  • Keyboard: type to filter, ↑ and ↓ to pick a card, Return to open it.
  • Dark website icons: black icons like GitHub's get a faint light plate in dark mode, so they don't vanish.

This is the first version that can arrive through the Update button: if you're on 0.1.9, just click Update.

item.title: Glint 0.1.9
item.description:
Glint now updates itself.

  • Updates from inside Glint: once a day Glint checks for a new version and downloads it in the background. When it's ready, an Update button appears in the toolbar: one click restarts into it, with your windows and tabs back. Or just quit, and it installs.
  • Check any time: Glint ▸ Check for Updates…, or Settings ▸ About.
  • The last manual install: after this version, you won't need to download Glint again.

Signed and notarized by Apple: open the .dmg, drag Glint to Applications and replace the old copy.
